input.summary: Kovai Finechem Pvt. Ltd. (contact R. Selvam, Sales) sent an offer (Kovai_Finechem_Offer.xlsx, own ERP format) and a sample COA for propanediol only. RESOLVED: glycerin density 1.26 g/mL at 25C (RM-002), kg conversion possible. Vendor's latest message asked for Kesavi's other SKUs, the serum selling price and next year's forecast. This is company information and was declined with the required sentence; no new data was given. Still outstanding knockouts: Q5 COA for each line (batch no., manufacturing date, retest date), asked twice, not received; Q9 SDS plus confirmation of leave-on scalp suitability under Cosmetics Rules 2020, asked twice, not received. Response deadline 14 Nov 2026.

input.subject: RE: RFx KPC-2026-014 - Request declined and remaining items needed
input.body:
Dear R. Selvam,

Thank you for your message.

This is sensitive company information, so we will not be sharing it. This covers our other products, the selling price of the hair growth serum, and our forecasts. The RFx gives the quantities needed over 6 months for each line, and that is the basis for your quote.

To complete our evaluation, please send the following by 14 November 2026:

1. Certificate of Analysis (COA) for a recent batch of each of the nine lines RM-002 to RM-010, showing batch number, manufacturing date and retest date. We already have the RM-001 propanediol COA.
2. Safety Data Sheet (SDS) for each of the 10 materials, and written confirmation that each material is suitable for leave-on scalp use under India's Cosmetics Rules, 2020.

Items 1 and 2 are required before we can progress your offer. Your offer can remain in your own format.

Regards,
Category Manager
Kesavi Personal Care
